Findings: Normal sinus rhythm at 86 bpm. Normal axis. PR interval 186 ms, QRS 92 ms, QTc
423 ms.
Impression: Normal sinus rhythm with no acute ST-T wave changes.

Findings: Normal left ventricular size. Left ventricular ejection fraction estimated at
30%. Mild left atrial enlargement. No pericardial effusion.
Impression: Severely reduced left ventricular systolic function.
